Class FightAnimator

java.lang.Object
views.fight.FightAnimator
public class FightAnimator extends Object
Handles all JavaFX animations for the fight screen.

Extracted from FightView to respect the Single Responsibility Principle. Responsible for: attack lunge, hit flash + HP bar decrease, and KO fade-out.

The hideCallback is invoked by animateKO(BugemonDTO, Runnable) to hide the fainted Bugémon's UI elements (sprite, HP bar, labels) after the fade completes. It is provided by FightView via a method reference to its own handleVisibility helper.

  • Method Details

    • animateAttack

      public void animateAttack(BugemonDTO bugemon, Runnable afterAttackAnimation)
      Plays a forward-lunge then recoil animation for the attacking Bugémon.

      Player lunges right (+60 px), enemy lunges left (−60 px). The sprite is snapped back to translateX = 0 before the callback fires.

      Parameters:
      bugemon - the attacking Bugémon (used to pick the right sprite)
      afterAttackAnimation - optional callback run after the animation completes

    • animateHit

      public void animateHit(BugemonDTO bugemon, Runnable afterHitAnimation)
      Plays a red-flash effect on the hit Bugémon while simultaneously animating the HP bar down to its new value.

      The DTO must already reflect the new HP before this method is called. Both the flash and the HP timeline run in parallel; the callback fires when both finish.

      Parameters:
      bugemon - the Bugémon that was hit (DTO already updated with new HP)
      afterHitAnimation - optional callback run after the animation completes

    • animateKO

      public void animateKO(BugemonDTO bugemon, Runnable afterKOAnimation)
      Plays a fade-out animation on the KO'd Bugémon's sprite, then hides its UI elements via the hideCallback before running the callback.
      Parameters:
      bugemon - the KO'd Bugémon
      afterKOAnimation - optional callback run after the animation and hide complete
